critique.evidence: The oversized “One payment. Two very different answers.” thesis and the selected-event trace culminating in a LEGACY STEP_UP versus INTENT INTEGRITY ALLOW comparison create a clear, screen-specific demo narrative. Cyan, yellow, and red accents reinforce the policy conflict. However, most of the visible experience remains a familiar dark security table with badges and dense metadata; the core contrast is visually modest and moves below eight repetitive rows on tablet/mobile, weakening the memorable reveal.
critique.fix: Make the policy divergence the dominant visual event: animate or diagram the selected payment splitting into two decision paths, keep the side-by-side verdicts visible while browsing events, and compress the mobile event list so the decisive STEP_UP versus ALLOW reveal appears within the first viewport.
